name: Fractal Tree
author: hoaxpoet
description: Recursive binary tree - low-fidelity graphic branch-fan in a fixed psychedelic palette, green at the trunk through cyan and violet to magenta at the tips, where every branch level carries its own color. The tree DANCES: it bounces on every beat and sways across each bar, with the motion rippling outward from the trunk so the fine branches follow a beat behind, and the finest tips wink in and out on the beat with the dance. Underneath it holds ONE size and steps to a new one when a sound lands, so the tree is small in a sparse passage and full in a dense one and still in between. The outer tips spark brighter the moment a sound lands, the canopy opens as the spectrum changes, and the tone deepens with the music's energy.
caption: A branching tree drawn in a few flat strokes, its color running from green at the first fork through blue and violet to magenta at the tips. It bounces on every beat and sways across the bar, the motion rippling outward so the finest branches follow a beat behind. Underneath it holds one size and steps to a new one when a sound lands — small in a sparse passage, full in a dense one.
